A team of 4 questionably qualified goobers tries their absolute best at interdimensional package delivery. Fun with friends, still surprisingly playable solo. Remember to bring a trusty crowbar if you value your survival.

Perfect for a quick and fun gaming session with friends, it can be pretty challenging so you surely won't get bored. The maps are all different and have various obstacles and enemies, even though at first you only get two types of missions. I played with two friends and we had a lot of fun, even if we didn't complete many missions (I think the ideal number of people would be 4 or more). Highly recommended if you want something chaotic, but be ready to have friendships challenged!

Controls leave a lot to be desired. It's not comfortable to play, playing Multiplayer is bad because of the way the server enforces itself onto the client, making you snap back and stopping you from moving.

I genuinely think this will be an amazing friendslop (idk why people call it slop, I like this stuff a lot) game! I had a lot of fun screaming at monsters and leading my friends through the maps haphazardly all while squeaking a rubber chicken! I get to gamble, cosplay as a Guy Fieri dressed in a school girl uniform, and kill enemies with TNT! This game is still in early access, so there's a lot of bugs and such to be expected. That being said, I wanted to write down what I think should either be looked at, changed, or outright removed: - Arachnophobia mode is a must, even if that spider monster has a cat head - No matter how low I turned down audios, it stayed at the same volume unless I adjusted the master volume - Multiplayer is fine for the host, but for the rest, they'd get pulled around randomly - Sometimes trying to go into buildings makes you automatically go back out, we're not sure on why - Please...please remove the holding box mechanic. I understand what it's for, but because there's so much going on with everything else already, I don't think it's needed I'm still going to pull as many friends into this game as possible, I think they'll love this. I cannot wait to see what the final version of this looks like, I'll be keeping my eyes on this!

Alright, I decided to try this game after a friend recommended it to me. I’m not, or at least I wasn’t, a fan of this genre, but when the 4 of us played it together we almost got kicked out of the house because of the screaming, laughing, and nonstop swearing during the match. Maybe the several beers helped, but this is definitely one of those games that completely pulls you in, pushes teamwork to the limit with plenty of arguments and total panic moments included. Absolutely not recommended during sleeping hours, unless you want to get kicked out of your house.

I first got it and was crashing every 3 minutes but they patched it, It was fun but we had some runs where the packages werent able to be picked up and a couple maps that had nothing but dead ends. It was otherwise fun and fun though the Voice chat audio seems way quiet than most other games like this ive played even on max volume. I also find that weird since the game is way louder in every other category than most games. I enjoyed the options of killing alot of monsters its way more than most other games in the genre. I found it fun but unless you got at least 2 other friends to play with id wait for it to get more content.

This game has an amazing concept... im giving a bad review for it only due to the enemy spawn rate, and enemy spawn capacity on it is outrageously not balanced. was playing a map after having first review and chose a 2 skull map where we were to deliver 2 packages. a minute into the map we ran into 10 enemies in same corridor.. we defeated them dropped the packages off went to leave the delivery room and the room past the delivery room to exit the room filled with enemies that were invisble one hitters and over 30 enemies.. started a new save file and first run on a 1 skull ran into 15 enemies in the starting room as soon as you entered the factory. at this point the game has become unplayable due to it drains the fun out the game. a 1 or even 2 skull difficulty shouldn't even be populated like it was a 5 or higher skull map. its a lil excessive on monster spawn and i believe unnecessary for a game to be good. i get it a 5 dollar game but it is not needed. this game has to much wasted potential.

Performance issues aside, game is half cooked, maybe if they fix the movement, mouse feeling slugish when playing this game, it can be good but right now this game is giving me a lot of motion sickness from all the weird screen movement
